items.title: Commission opens investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct by Omya in the supply of calcium carbonates to the paper industry
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 23 Oct 2026 The European Commission has opened a formal antitrust investigation to assess whether Omya has breached EU competition rules by requiring customers in the paper industry to purchase all or most of their calcium carbonates from Omya.

items.title: Commission welcomes commitments of Coca-Cola, Nestlé, and Danone to modify recycling claims on plastic bottles
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 Oct 2026 Following a dialogue with the European Commission and the Consumer Protection Cooperation (CPC) network, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, and Danone have committed to change recycling claims advertised on their plastic bottles.
